name: Autumn Reeser
bio: ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Autumn Alicia Reeser (born September 21, 1980 height 5' 4" (1,63 m) ) is an American actress. She has portrayed Taylor Townsend on the Fox series The O.C., and most recently appeared as Katie Andrews on ABC's No Ordinary Family.
